rules.title: oMLX old logs
rules.description: Rotated server logs from previous days. The current log and models are kept.

rules.title: oMLX prompt cache
rules.description: Saved prompt state that speeds up repeated requests. It is rebuilt as you use oMLX; models are not touched.

rules.title: Ollama old logs
rules.description: Rotated server logs (server-1.log and older). The current log and models are kept.

rules.title: LM Studio server logs
rules.description: Local server logs older than a week. Models and chats are kept.

rules.title: LM Studio app cache
rules.description: Web and graphics caches of the LM Studio window, rebuilt when it opens. Models and chats are kept.
